فُقْأَةٌ : see فَقْءٌ, in two places. ―
-b2- Also (tropical:) A cloud in which is neither thunder nor lightning, and the rain of which is مُتَقَارِب [app. meaning drawing near: as though likened to the membrane thus called]. (O, * TA. [In the former written, in this instance, فَقْأَةٌ, which I think to be a mistranscription by the copyist.])
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
